records.name: Ben Whitfield
records.text: ATS hire H-123: Ben Whitfield, Backend Engineer, started 2026-09-08. Source: Ferrous Guild (Rust and backend community job board). Recruiter: Jonah Reyes.

Channel retrospective, backend roles (Jonah Reyes, 2026-09-25): Ferrous Guild is our best source by a distance - 5 backend hires since June and all 5 are still here, not one regretted exit. LinkedIn Recruiter kept 4 of its 6 backend hires, referrals 4 of 5. Lead every backend req with Ferrous Guild, and drop the LinkedIn Recruiter seat at renewal.

Channel retrospective, data roles (Jonah Reyes, 2026-09-25): referrals beat LinkedIn for data hires - all 3 referral hires are still here, LinkedIn Recruiter lost 1 of 3. Lead data reqs with an employee-referral push.
